speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help us understand the cause of your fatigue and itching, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, and has your urine become dark in color?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis, have you noticed any pale or clay-colored stools, and do you experience any right upper quadrant abdominal pain? I need to rule out primary sclerosing cholangitis or other biliary causes.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis and signs of cholestasis, I need to rule out primary sclerosing cholangitis. REQUEST TEST: MRCP

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the MRCP is normal, we must look for other causes of cholestasis, such as autoimmune hepatitis or primary biliary cholangitis. Do you have a history of alcohol consumption, and have you started any new medications or supplements recently?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Hypertension, Ulcerative Colitis Social history: Sexually active with inconsistent condom use

speaker: Doctor
text: I see you haven't mentioned alcohol use or new medications yet. Do you drink alcohol regularly, and have you started any new prescriptions or supplements in the last few months?

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, diarrhea, joint pain, or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to rule out viral hepatitis given your sexual history, so please confirm if you drink alcohol regularly or have started any new medications or supplements recently. REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis B and C Serology

speaker: Doctor
text: With viral and biliary causes ruled out, I suspect an autoimmune etiology given your history of ulcerative colitis. REQUEST TEST: Antinuclear Antibody (ANA) and Anti-Mitochondrial Antibody (AMA)

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal biopsy and serology, I need to check for other autoimmune markers or metabolic issues. REQUEST TEST: Anti-Smooth Muscle Antibody (ASMA) and Liver Function Tests (ALT, AST, ALP, Bilirubin)

text: RESULTS: ALT: 78 U/L, AST: 75 U/L, Alkaline Phosphatase: 460 U/L, Bilirubin_Total: 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct: 0.9 mg/dL

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the strong association with ulcerative colitis, severe pruritus, cholestatic liver enzymes, and the exclusion of viral, alcoholic, and other autoimmune causes, the clinical picture is highly suggestive of IgG4-related sclerosing cholangitis or a variant of primary sclerosing cholangitis not visible on standard MRCP. DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis
